text: Reworked the Slidev pitch deck in code/pitch into a plainer, picture-first talk: an IncomingCall Teams-style popover on slide 01 plays a gitignored public/ringtone.mp3 (copied from assets/teams.mp3) and hangs up to the next slide, and the order became scene, transcript, live demo, benefits, values, outlook, with backup slides after Thank you. The demo story moved from a login API to a running-club newsletter sign-up, with slides 01 and 02 and DEMO.md (setup plus five prompts) rewritten to match. Everything is uncommitted; the ringing-after-navigation bug is fixed and checked in headless Chromium, but slide 02's extra right-column transcript lines were overwritten repeatedly by an external save of slides.md and are still missing, and ui/react-flow-graph is behind main, where its React Flow work was already merged in f4df284.
